name: meta_update
description: Create or update a metadata record in z-meta. Use this when the CEO agent needs to register a new API, add a dictionary entry, or register a new application. The operation is idempotent (POST creates new or updates existing based on natural key). Returns the created/updated record. Backed by /api/interface (POST), /api/dict/item (POST), /api/meta-app (POST). Requires z-ctc 'meta:write' permission.

data.description: The metadata record. Schema depends on metaType. e.g. for 'interface': {path, method, appName, description, requestSchema, responseSchema}. For 'dict': {dictType, itemKey, itemValue, description}. For 'app': {appCode, appName, appSecret, owner}.
